name: Smoke test 15 min, SP wide window (BNC direct)
description: SMOKE TEST + SP CHARACTERISATION after the slip-ring sensor was moved to a DIRECT BNC CABLE (Kim, 2026-10-20). Same schedule as NoiseFloor_SmokeTest_15min - 2 min at rest, then 600/1800/3000 rpm for 2 min each, then 7 min at rest - but SP's window is opened from 8.0/4.5 to 32.0/1.5 because the new cabling changed the signal completely. WHY: with a 10x probe the scope divided at the input and multiplied by 10 in software, so SP read a steady +4.99 V. With a direct BNC cable the channel had to be set to PROBE 1x (done 2026-10-20, it had been 10x in every archived run) and the signal is now different: at rest +0.37 V mean, and with the motor running +4.7 V mean swinging -2.8 to +5.6 V, i.e. 8.4 Vpp. The old 0.5-8.5 V window would clip every negative excursion. THE POINT OF THE WIDE WINDOW IS TO MEASURE, NOT TO KEEP: 32 V costs resolution (0.161 V steps, so the signal uses ~52 of the scope's ~199 usable levels against 139 at 1.5 V/div). Size the final window from this run's measured extent at 600/1800/3000 rpm and then narrow it, exactly as the August sizing was done - SP excursions grow with speed, and all current numbers come from 191 rpm only. NOTE the heater is NOT switched on for this run: a CLI run never energises it, and leaving it off keeps the relay's 50-100 kHz coupling out of the SP characterisation. The SV 40 setpoint is therefore inert. NOTE ALSO: the code records :CHANx:PROB as metadata but never SETS it, so the 1x setting is unmanaged front-panel state - verify probe_attenuation in the resulting h5.
